description: A desktop (JVM) playback engine for kmptoolkit-video-player built on JavaFX Media: createJavaFxVideoPlayer() returns the same VideoPlayer as on Android and iOS, and its frames render through kmptoolkit-video-player-compose. OpenJFX is licensed GPL-2.0 with the Classpath Exception and is a compileOnly dependency — the app adds the OpenJFX runtime jars for each OS it ships to. The alternative desktop engine is kmptoolkit-video-player-vlcj.
